review:
Haunted Coins x5000 is a Halloween take on Wazdan's Coins series, played on 9 reels with a Grand Jackpot worth 5,000x the bet, the biggest prize in this batch. Like the rest of the series, nearly everything builds towards the Hold the Jackpot respin bonus.

Cash Infinity symbols are worth more than regular cash symbols and stick to the reels until the end of the bonus. A Cash Out label can attach to the base game: it accumulates symbol values and pays a percentage when its countdown ends, after up to 20 spins. Chance Level multiplies the bet by up to 10x to make the bonus more likely. Wazdan lists a 96.15% RTP and very high volatility, so long quiet stretches are normal. Best for players chasing one big jackpot round.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
